workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 鈕扣 BPM 靈敏度與解析度練習：圓管半徑 R = 20 mm，四鈕扣在 ±45°，k_x = R/√2 = 14.1 mm。束流偏移 50 µm 時 Δ/Σ = 50 µm/14.1 mm ≈ 3.5×10⁻³。每電極 500 MHz 訊號為 −1.7 dBm，經 1 MHz 帶通濾波後熱雜訊 −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 109.3 dB，振幅相對雜訊 10^(−109.3/20) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶/2 = 1.7×10⁻⁶，σ_x ≈ 14.1 mm×1.7×10⁻⁶ ≈ 24 nm（理論熱雜訊極限）；實務上 ADC 與電子學雜訊讓逐圈解析度落在約 0.5 µm。若一路電纜增益偏 0.5%，假偏移為 14.1 mm×(0.005/4) ≈ 18 µm，是熱雜訊極限的數百倍，說明增益校正比低雜訊放大器更關鍵。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Button-BPM sensitivity and resolution exercise: pipe radius R = 20 mm, four buttons at ±45°, k_x = R/√2 = 14.1 mm. A 50 µm beam offset gives Δ/Σ = 50 µm/14.1 mm ≈ 3.5×10⁻³. Each electrode delivers −1.7 dBm at 500 MHz; after a 1 MHz band-pass the thermal noise −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 109.3 dB, the relative amplitude noise is 10^(−109.3/20) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶, σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶/2 = 1.7×10⁻⁶ and σ_x ≈ 14.1 mm×1.7×10⁻⁶ ≈ 24 nm as the thermal-noise limit; in practice ADC and electronics noise put turn-by-turn resolution near 0.5 µm. If one cable's gain is off by 0.5%, the false offset is 14.1 mm×(0.005/4) ≈ 18 µm, hundreds of times the thermal limit, showing that gain calibration matters more than a lower-noise amplifier. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bunch field and wall image current” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子束團以 γ ≫ 1 飛行時，其電場被勞倫茲收縮成張角約 1/γ 的薄盤，垂直於運動方向打在真空管壁上，在壁面感應出與束流電流大小相等、方向相反的鏡像電流。管壁上的任何電極只要截取一部分鏡像電流，就得到與束團縱向分佈相同時間形狀的訊號；因此位置監測器量的不是束團本身，而是鏡像電荷在圓周上的分佈。束團長度決定訊號頻寬，電極與電子學則在某個射頻諧波上處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An electron bunch travelling with γ ≫ 1 has its field Lorentz-contracted into a thin disc of opening angle about 1/γ, which strikes the vacuum-chamber wall perpendicular to the motion and induces an image current equal and opposite to the beam current. Any electrode in the wall that intercepts part of this image current produces a signal with the same time shape as the longitudinal bunch profile, so a position monitor measures the azimuthal distribution of image charge rather than the bunch itself. Bunch length sets the signal bandwidth, and the pickup and electronics process one RF harmonic of it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch field and wall image current”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈕扣電極量到的是束流直接打在電極上的電荷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A button pickup measures charge from the beam striking the electrode directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bunch field and wall image current”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bunch field and wall image current” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3 GeV 電子的 γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870，電場盤在半徑 20 mm 管壁上的縱向厚度約 R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm，遠小於束團長度，故壁電流忠實複製束團。束團 σ_z = 10 mm 對應 σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps，高斯頻譜在 f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz 處降到 e^(−1/2)；在 500 MHz 的處理頻率上 ωσ_t ≈ 0.10，形狀因子 exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995，幾乎不衰減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 3 GeV electron has γ = 3×10⁹/0.511×10⁶ ≈ 5870, so the field disc at a 20 mm wall radius is only about R/γ ≈ 3.4 µm thick, far shorter than the bunch, and the wall current faithfully copies the bunch. A bunch with σ_z = 10 mm has σ_t = σ_z/c ≈ 33 ps, and its Gaussian spectrum falls to e^(−1/2) near f ≈ 1/(2πσ_t) ≈ 4.8 GHz; at the 500 MHz processing frequency ωσ_t ≈ 0.10 and the form factor exp(−(ωσ_t)²/2) ≈ 0.995 is nearly unity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束團電場與管壁鏡像電流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bunch field and wall image current” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把電極放在管徑突變處，鏡像電流在幾何不連續點被打散成尾場，電極訊號被寄生模振盪污染，位置讀數隨填充模式漂移數十微米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Placing the pickup at an abrupt change of chamber cross-section breaks the image current into wakefields at the discontinuity; the electrode signal is contaminated by trapped-mode ringing and the reading drifts by tens of micrometres with the fill pattern.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch"?
options: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。
optionsEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher feedback bandwidth is always better, and maximum gain suppresses all noise.
quiz.explanation: 用寬頻示波器直接觀察單一鈕扣的時域脈衝，與條紋相機或同步輻射量到的束團長度比較脈衝寬度；再以頻譜分析儀量 500 MHz 諧波功率對束流電流的線性關係，確認訊號正比於鏡像電流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: View a single button's time-domain pulse on a wide-band oscilloscope and compare its width with the bunch length from a streak camera or synchrotron-light monitor; then measure the 500 MHz harmonic power against beam current with a spectrum analyzer to confirm linearity with the image current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 相對論束團的鏡像電流與訊號頻譜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Image current and signal spectrum of a relativistic bunch: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四鈕扣差和比」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Four-button difference-over-sum” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓管內束流偏離中心 x 時，壁面鏡像電荷密度對角度 θ 的分佈為 (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ))，小位移時近似 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ。四個鈕扣放在 ±45° 與 ±135°，把對角兩組的和相減再除以四者總和，得到與 x 成正比而與束流電流無關的差和比；y 方向同理。靈敏度由管半徑與電極位置決定，非線性項隨 (r/R)³ 增長，所以大位移需要用邊界元素計算或實驗室校正表修正。解析度則由各電極訊號的訊雜比與處理頻寬決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四鈕扣差和比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the beam is displaced by x inside a round pipe, the wall image-charge density versus angle θ is (λ/2πR)·(R² − r²)/(R² + r² − 2rR·cos(θ − φ)), approximately 1 + 2(x/R)cosθ for small displacement. Four buttons at ±45° and ±135° give, by subtracting the two diagonal pair sums and dividing by the total, a difference-over-sum ratio proportional to x and independent of beam current; y follows the same logic. Sensitivity is set by pipe radius and electrode positions, and the nonlinear terms grow as (r/R)³, so large displacements need boundary-element calculations or a laboratory calibration map. Resolution is set by the signal-to-noise ratio of each electrode and the processing bandwidth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four-button difference-over-sum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「差和比正比於束流電流，所以電流越大位置讀數越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Difference-over-sum is proportional to beam current, so more current gives a larger position reading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四鈕扣差和比」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Difference-over-sum sensitivity and position resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四鈕扣差和比」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Four-button difference-over-sum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：45° 配置下 Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R，即 x = k_x·Δ/Σ，k_x = R/√2。R = 20 mm 時 k_x = 14.1 mm，x = 100 µm 給出 Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³。若每個電極在 1 MHz 頻寬內的訊號功率為 −20 dBm，熱雜訊 kTB = −114 dBm 加 3 dB 雜訊指數為 −111 dBm，功率訊雜比 91 dB，振幅相對雜訊 σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵；四電極的 σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵，位置解析度 σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the 45° layout Δ/Σ = [(A + D) − (B + C)]/(A + B + C + D) ≈ √2·x/R, i.e. x = k_x·Δ/Σ with k_x = R/√2. For R = 20 mm, k_x = 14.1 mm and x = 100 µm gives Δ/Σ = 7.1×10⁻³. If each electrode delivers −20 dBm in a 1 MHz bandwidth while thermal noise kTB = −114 dBm plus a 3 dB noise figure is −111 dBm, the power SNR is 91 dB, the relative amplitude noise is σ_V/V = 10^(−91/20) ≈ 2.8×10⁻⁵, four electrodes give σ(Δ/Σ) ≈ σ_V/(2V) ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵, and the position resolution is σ_x = k_x·1.4×10⁻⁵ ≈ 0.2 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 差和比靈敏度與位置解析度：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四鈕扣差和比」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Four-button difference-over-sum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗室用張緊的導線模擬束流，以 500 MHz 訊號饋入並用精密平台移動導線，記錄 Δ/Σ 對位移的曲線，擬合線性係數 k_x 與三次項；比較擬合值與 R/√2 的理論值，差異通常來自電極有限尺寸，應在 10% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the laboratory emulate the beam with a stretched wire driven at 500 MHz, move it with a precision stage, record Δ/Σ versus displacement and fit the linear coefficient k_x and the cubic term; compare the fitted k_x with the theoretical R/√2, where the difference, usually from finite electrode size, should stay within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在離軸 5 mm 處仍用線性公式，三次項使讀數低估約 10%，用來做軌道校正時收斂到錯誤的軌道；束流尺寸的四極項也會在大偏移時混入位置讀數。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using the linear formula at 5 mm off-axis lets the cubic term underestimate the reading by about 10%, so orbit correction converges to the wrong orbit; the quadrupolar beam-size term also leaks into the position reading at large offsets.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.objective: 說明「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鈕扣是一片直徑數毫米的金屬圓片，經陶瓷絕緣的 50 Ω 同軸饋通引出；它對管壁有數 pF 的電容 C_b。鏡像電流截取的比例近似於鈕扣面積除以管壁周長乘以束團長度，形成一個電流源推動 C_b 與 50 Ω 負載的並聯：低頻時訊號正比於 ω（微分特性），高於轉折頻率 1/(2π·50 Ω·C_b) 後趨於平坦。轉移阻抗 Z_t 把束流的頻譜分量轉成電極電壓，是設計電子學增益與功率預算的起點。條帶電極（stripline）與腔式 BPM 分別以行波方向性與偶極模共振取得更高靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A button is a metal disc of a few millimetres diameter brought out through a ceramic-insulated 50 Ω coaxial feedthrough, with a capacitance C_b of a few picofarads to the wall. The fraction of image current it intercepts is about the button area divided by the wall circumference, forming a current source that drives C_b in parallel with the 50 Ω load: at low frequency the signal is proportional to ω (differentiating), and above the corner frequency 1/(2π·50 Ω·C_b) it flattens. The transfer impedance Z_t converts each spectral component of the beam current into electrode voltage and is the starting point for electronics gain and power budgets. Stripline pickups and cavity BPMs reach higher sensitivity through travelling-wave directivity and dipole-mode resonance respectively. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With C_b = 5 pF the corner frequency is f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz.

steps.title: 電極轉移阻抗與電容轉折頻率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鈕扣電極與 50 Ω 饋通」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Button electrode and 50 Ω feedthrough” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C_b = 5 pF 時轉折頻率 f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz。高頻漸近轉移阻抗 |Z_t,∞| = A/(2πR·βc·C_b)：A = 78.5 mm²（直徑 10 mm）、2πR = 125.7 mm、c·C_b = 1.5×10⁻³ m·Ω⁻¹，得 0.42 Ω；在 500 MHz 時 ωRC = 0.785，|Z_t| = 0.42×0.785/√(1 + 0.785²) ≈ 0.26 Ω。儲存環平均電流 500 mA 的 500 MHz 傅立葉振幅約 2×0.5 = 1.0 A，電極電壓振幅約 0.26 V，饋入 50 Ω 的功率 V²/(2×50) ≈ 0.68 mW ≈ −1.7 dBm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With C_b = 5 pF the corner frequency is f_c = 1/(2π×50×5×10⁻¹²) ≈ 637 MHz. The high-frequency asymptote of the transfer impedance is |Z_t,∞| = A/(2πR·βc·C_b): A = 78.5 mm² (10 mm diameter), 2πR = 125.7 mm and c·C_b = 1.5×10⁻³ m·Ω⁻¹ give 0.42 Ω; at 500 MHz, ωRC = 0.785 and |Z_t| = 0.42×0.785/√(1 + 0.785²) ≈ 0.26 Ω. A 500 mA storage-ring current has a 500 MHz Fourier amplitude of about 2×0.5 = 1.0 A, so the electrode voltage amplitude is about 0.26 V and the power into 50 Ω is V²/(2×50) ≈ 0.68 mW ≈ −1.7 dBm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容；在測試台以導線激發量 Z_t 的頻率響應並與公式比較；安裝後以已知束流電流下量到的 500 MHz 功率反推 Z_t，三者應一致在 1 dB 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each feedthrough's impedance discontinuity and button capacitance with a vector network analyzer in time-domain reflectometry; on the wire test bench measure the frequency response of Z_t and compare with the formula; after installation back out Z_t from the 500 MHz power at a known beam current, and require the three to agree within 1 dB.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 用向量網路分析儀以時域反射法量每個饋通的阻抗不連續與鈕扣電容；在測試台以導線激發量 Z_t 的頻率響應並與公式比較；安裝後以已知束流電流下量到的 500 MHz 功率反推 Z_t，三者應一致在 1 dB 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: BPM 本體由不鏽鋼或鋁整體加工，四個饋通孔位的機械公差在數十微米，外側加工出測量基準面供雷射追蹤儀測量，把電極幾何中心連到儲存環的測量網。電氣中心與機械中心不一致的來源有：電極尺寸與電容差異、電纜衰減差異、電子學通道增益差異。因為差和比對四路增益極敏感，任何通道的 1% 差異就是數十微米的假偏移，所以工程上以通道交叉切換、導頻（pilot tone）或束流基準對準把增益誤差移出量測鏈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The BPM block is machined from one piece of stainless steel or aluminium with the four feedthrough ports toleranced to tens of micrometres, and external fiducial surfaces are machined so that a laser tracker can tie the electrode geometric centre to the ring survey network. The electrical centre departs from the mechanical centre because of electrode size and capacitance differences, cable attenuation differences and electronics channel gains. Since difference-over-sum is extremely sensitive to the four gains, a 1% mismatch in any channel is a false offset of tens of micrometres, so engineering removes gain error from the chain by channel crossbar switching, a pilot tone or beam-based alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Let one of four electrodes have gain 1.01 with the beam centred: Δ = (1.01 + 1) − (1 + 1) = 0.01, Σ = 4.01, Δ/Σ ≈ 2.5×10⁻³ and the false offset is x = 14.1 mm×2.5×10⁻³ ≈ 35 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要四個鈕扣機械上對稱，電氣中心就等於機械中心。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the four buttons are mechanically symmetric, the electrical centre equals the mechanical centre." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 機械製作、基準面與增益失衡的偏移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mechanical fabrication, fiducials and gain-imbalance offset: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BPM 本體、基準面與電氣中心」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BPM block, fiducials and electrical centre” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設四電極中有一路增益為 1.01、其餘為 1，束流在中心：Δ = (1.01 + 1) − (1 + 1) = 0.01，Σ = 4.01，Δ/Σ ≈ 2.5×10⁻³，假偏移 x = 14.1 mm×2.5×10⁻³ ≈ 35 µm。同軸電纜衰減的溫度係數約 0.2%/K，10 dB 的電纜溫差 1 K 造成約 0.02 dB（0.46%）的增益差，相當於約 16 µm 的漂移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Let one of four electrodes have gain 1.01 with the beam centred: Δ = (1.01 + 1) − (1 + 1) = 0.01, Σ = 4.01, Δ/Σ ≈ 2.5×10⁻³ and the false offset is x = 14.1 mm×2.5×10⁻³ ≈ 35 µm. Coaxial-cable attenuation has a temperature coefficient of about 0.2%/K, so a 1 K difference on a 10 dB cable gives about 0.02 dB (0.46%) of gain mismatch, equivalent to about 16 µm of drift. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作後用三次元量床量四個饋通孔相對基準面的位置；安裝前在導線測試台量電氣中心對機械中心的偏移並存入資料庫；上線後用導頻或切換法持續量四通道增益比，與實驗室值比對，差異超過 0.1 dB 時觸發檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After machining, measure the four port positions relative to the fiducials on a coordinate-measuring machine; before installation measure the electrical-to-mechanical centre offset on the wire bench and store it in the database; once operating, track the four channel gain ratios continuously with a pilot tone or crossbar switching, compare with laboratory values and flag any change beyond 0.1 dB.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軌道控制真正需要的是束流相對四極磁鐵磁中心的位置，因為通過四極中心的束流不受偏轉。束流基準對準的做法是改變某個四極的強度，若束流偏離其磁中心，就會產生與偏移成正比的踢角，造成全環軌道變化；調整局部軌道直到四極強度改變不再引起軌道變化，此時 BPM 讀數就是該 BPM 對四極中心的偏移。這個偏移同時包含電氣中心誤差與機械安裝誤差，是後續所有軌道校正的零點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: What orbit control really needs is the beam position relative to the quadrupole magnetic centre, because a beam through that centre is not deflected. Beam-based alignment changes the strength of one quadrupole; if the beam is off its magnetic centre, a kick proportional to the offset appears and the whole-ring orbit changes. The local orbit is adjusted until a strength change no longer moves the orbit, and the BPM reading at that point is its offset from the quadrupole centre. This offset contains both the electrical-centre error and the mechanical installation error and becomes the zero point for all later orbit correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 束流基準對準與電子學校正：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四極磁鐵束流基準對準」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-based alignment to the quadrupole” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四極強度改變 Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹、束流偏移 x_q = 100 µm 時踢角 Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad。下游 BPM 的軌道變化 Δx = Δθ·√(β_q·β)·cos(Δφ − πν)/(2 sin πν)；取 √(β_q·β) = 10 m、ν = 14.2（2 sin πν ≈ 1.18）、cos 項 ≈ 1，Δx ≈ 1×10⁻⁶×10/1.18 ≈ 8.5 µm。BPM 解析度 1 µm 時，對準精度約 100 µm×(1/8.5) ≈ 12 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A quadrupole strength change Δ(kL) = 0.01 m⁻¹ with a beam offset x_q = 100 µm gives a kick Δθ = Δ(kL)·x_q = 1 µrad. With 1 µm BPM resolution the alignment precision is about 100 µm×(1/8.5) ≈ 12 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個四極做正負兩個方向的強度調變並掃描局部軌道，擬合軌道變化對 BPM 讀數的直線，零交點即偏移；重複三次取標準差作為對準不確定度，並與雷射追蹤儀的機械測量值比較，差異應在機械公差內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Modulate each quadrupole in both polarities while scanning the local orbit, fit a straight line of orbit change against BPM reading, and take the zero crossing as the offset; repeat three times and use the standard deviation as the alignment uncertainty, then compare with the laser-tracker mechanical survey, which should agree within mechanical tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: BPM 的誤差預算要分三個時間尺度：逐圈（turn-by-turn）量測受熱雜訊與 ADC 量化限制，解析度隨頻寬平方根變差；慢軌道量測以 10 kHz 以下頻寬把雜訊平均掉；長期穩定則由電纜、電子學與機械的溫度漂移主導。解析度不能只靠電子學自測，要用三 BPM 相關法：用兩個 BPM 的讀數經傳輸矩陣預測中間 BPM 的位置，殘差的分佈寬度反映真實解析度。束流電流變化、填充模式與束流尺寸也會透過電子學非線性混入讀數，都要在預算表中各佔一列。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三 BPM 相關法與漂移紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Resolution cannot be certified by the electronics alone, so the three-BPM correlation is used: two BPM readings predict the middle one through transfer matrices and the residual width reflects the true resolution. Beam-current changes, fill pattern and beam size also leak into readings through electronics nonlinearity and each takes a line in the budget. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-BPM correlation and drift log” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三 BPM 法：x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃，殘差變異數 σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²)。量到 σ_res = 1.5 µm、a = b = 0.5，則 σ = 1.5/√1.5 ≈ 1.22 µm。頻寬縮放：逐圈 500 kHz 頻寬下 σ = 1.2 µm，換成 10 Hz 的慢軌道頻寬，σ ≈ 1.2×√(10/5×10⁵) ≈ 5 nm，此時實際極限轉為電子學 1/f 雜訊與漂移，而非熱雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three-BPM method: x₂,pred = a·x₁ + b·x₃ with residual variance σ_res² = σ²(1 + a² + b²). steps.observation: 如何核對：以穩定儲存束記錄 24 小時逐圈與慢軌道數據，計算三 BPM 殘差隨頻寬的變化並與 √B 定律比較；同時記錄機房溫度與電纜溫度，對讀數做相關分析取得每 K 的漂移係數，填入預算表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With a stable stored beam record 24 hours of turn-by-turn and slow-orbit data, compute the three-BPM residual versus bandwidth and compare with the √B law; log rack and cable temperatures in parallel, correlate them with the readings to extract a drift coefficient per kelvin and enter it in the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速軌道回授迴路」如何決定加速器束流位置監測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast orbit-feedback loop” determines the key performance of “Accelerator beam-position monitoring”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位 BPM 電子學把四路射頻訊號經帶通濾波與 ADC 取樣，在 FPGA 中做數位下變頻、濾波與差和比計算，輸出逐圈、快速（10 kHz）與慢速三種資料流。快速資料經低延遲網路送到軌道回授控制器，控制器用反應矩陣的奇異值分解求出校正磁鐵電流，壓制地面振動、冷卻水與電源波動造成的軌道雜訊。整合還包括時序（與迴旋頻率同步的觸發）、束流位置連鎖（保護插件磁鐵與真空腔）以及所有校正常數的集中管理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速軌道回授迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Digital BPM electronics band-pass filter and sample the four RF signals, then perform digital down-conversion, filtering and the difference-over-sum computation in an FPGA, delivering turn-by-turn, fast (10 kHz) and slow data streams. The fast stream goes over a low-latency network to the orbit-feedback controller, which inverts the response matrix by singular-value decomposition to set corrector-magnet currents that suppress orbit noise from ground motion, cooling water and power-supply ripple. Integration also covers timing (triggers locked to the revolution frequency), a beam-position interlock protecting insertion devices and the vacuum chamber, and central management of all calibration constants. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast orbit-feedback loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回授頻寬越高越好，把增益開到最大就能壓掉所有雜訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 電子學、時序與快速軌道回授整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electronics, timing and fast orbit-feedback integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速軌道回授迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast orbit-feedback loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光源要求軌道穩定在束流尺寸的 10%：垂直 σ_y = 10 µm 時目標 1 µm。回授迴路頻寬 f_bw = 150 Hz 時，對遠低於 f_bw 的擾動抑制比約為 f/f_bw：10 Hz 的地面振動擾動 15 µm 被壓到 15×(10/150) = 1 µm；對 50 Hz 電源漣波僅壓到 1/3；100 Hz 以上幾乎無效，必須從源頭消除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A light source requires orbit stability at 10% of the beam size: with σ_y = 10 µm the target is 1 µm. With a feedback bandwidth f_bw = 150 Hz the suppression of disturbances well below f_bw is about f/f_bw: a 15 µm ground-motion disturbance at 10 Hz is reduced to 15×(10/150) = 1 µm; 50 Hz mains ripple is only cut to one third; above 100 Hz the loop is nearly ineffective and the source must be removed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣；閉迴路後比較回授開關前後的軌道功率譜密度，確認抑制曲線與設計的 f/f_bw 一致，並確認沒有在 f_bw 附近出現雜訊放大峰。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In open loop inject a known sinusoidal disturbance with one corrector and record the BPM response to verify the response matrix; in closed loop compare orbit power spectral densities with feedback on and off, confirm the suppression curve matches the designed f/f_bw, and check that no noise-amplification peak appears near f_bw.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 開迴路時用一個校正磁鐵注入已知正弦擾動並量 BPM 響應，驗證反應矩陣；閉迴路後比較回授開關前後的軌道功率譜密度，確認抑制曲線與設計的 f/f_bw 一致，並確認沒有在 f_bw 附近出現雜訊放大峰。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 交接的核心是一份可重現的校正常數集：每個 BPM 的 k_x、k_y 與非線性多項式、實驗室電氣中心偏移、束流基準對準偏移、通道增益歷史、三 BPM 解析度與長期漂移係數。試運轉時逐一驗證極性（移動軌道確認讀數方向）、增益（與已知磁鐵踢角比較）、時序（逐圈資料對應正確的束團）與連鎖門檻，並把結果寫入驗收報告。之後任何電纜更換或電子學維修都必須觸發對應項目的重新校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正常數資料庫與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The heart of the handoff is a reproducible set of calibration constants: each BPM's k_x, k_y and nonlinearity polynomial, the laboratory electrical-centre offset, the beam-based alignment offset, channel-gain history, three-BPM resolution and long-term drift coefficients. steps.failure: 常見誤解：「BPM 的校正常數做一次就永久有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 試運轉驗證與工程交接：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：增益驗證：校正磁鐵踢角 20 µrad，模型預測某 BPM 位移 Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm；量到 160 µm，比值 1.046，表示 k_x 需修正 4.6%，超過 2% 的驗收門檻必須回到導線台重新校正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Gain verification: a 20 µrad corrector kick predicts at some BPM Δx_model = 20×10⁻⁶×√(β₁β₂)·|sin Δφ|/(2 sin πν) = 20×10⁻⁶×10×0.9/1.18 ≈ 153 µm; a measured 160 µm gives a ratio of 1.046, meaning k_x needs a 4.6% correction, beyond the 2% acceptance threshold, so the unit goes back to the wire bench for re-calibration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用全環校正磁鐵逐一踢束流，建立量測反應矩陣並與光學模型矩陣比較，對每個 BPM 擬合增益與極性；把校正常數的版本、量測日期與操作者寫入資料庫，交接時隨機抽取三個 BPM 從原始數據重算常數，確認可重現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Kick the beam with every corrector in turn, build the measured response matrix, compare it with the optics-model matrix and fit gain and polarity for each BPM; store version, date and operator of every constant in the database, and at handoff recompute the constants of three randomly chosen BPMs from raw data to prove reproducibility.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
